emails.subject: Greenhouse quote — referral from Lori McG.
emails.preview: Hi — Lori said you were the only person who called her back last fall. I'm looking at a 24x48 build on our property in Watkinsville, flexible on timing but…
body: Lori McGalliard gave me your contact — she said you were the only person who actually called her back last fall and that her build turned out beautifully.

We've been planning a greenhouse for about two years. Our property backs onto a creek in Watkinsville and we've marked a flat spot about 40 feet from the water. Looking at a 24x48 footprint, nothing fancy but we want it done right the first time.
We're flexible on timing — ideally in the ground by spring but I'd rather wait and have you do it than rush with someone else. Budget is not the top concern.
Would love to set up a site visit when it works for you.

scopingCues.text: "done right" — quality buyer, not a price shopper
"flexible on timing" — can slot into your calendar
creek 40 ft away — flag drainage + permit at site visit

emails.subject: quick question about pricing
emails.preview: hey saw your site, what's the cheapest option you have? just need something basic for the backyard not looking to spend a lot…
body: saw your site, what's the cheapest option you have? just need something basic for the backyard not looking to spend a lot. budget is like $2k if that works. let me know!

scopingCues.text: budget 10× below your floor — not a fit
polite decline + a resource recs = goodwill, no revenue

emails.subject: treehouse greenhouse — concept help
emails.preview: We have a dead oak we want to build around. Is this something you do? Attaching reference photos…
body: We have a dead oak on our property that we don't want to cut down — it's a landmark on the lot. We'd love to build a greenhouse around the base and have it climb up into the lower branches. More decorative than production.
Is this something you do? I'm attaching two reference photos from Pinterest. Timeline is flexible, this is a dream project.

scopingCues.text: unusual = margin + portfolio piece if it closes
dead oak = structural question before you quote
